name: mygit-js
description: Cross-platform Git client (Web, Windows, macOS, Linux) sharing one JavaScript UI.
author: MyGit

scripts.build:win: node scripts/prepare-icons.mjs && vite build && node scripts/build-server.mjs && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis --x64 && node scripts/copy-installer.mjs
scripts.build:linux: node scripts/prepare-icons.mjs && vite build && node scripts/build-server.mjs && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64 && node scripts/copy-installer.mjs
scripts.build:mac: node scripts/prepare-icons.mjs && vite build && node scripts/build-server.mjs && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 && node scripts/copy-installer.mjs
scripts.build:web: vite build && node scripts/build-server.mjs && node scripts/package-web.mjs && node scripts/copy-installer.mjs
scripts.start:web: vite build && node scripts/build-server.mjs && node dist-server/cli.cjs
scripts.start:desktop: vite build && node scripts/build-server.mjs && cross-env MYGIT_MODE=prod electron .
scripts.dist: node scripts/prepare-icons.mjs && vite build && node scripts/build-server.mjs && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder && node scripts/copy-installer.mjs
